sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior repairs, but add the required adjacent-main-frame ice-strengthening check to the horizontal-connection alternative. When the intermediate frame has an allowed termination below a supporting structure at or below the ice-belt lower limit and connects to ?adjacentMainFrame, require ?adjacentMainFrame nltl:mainFrameBelowIceBeltStrengthened true. The current SPARQL checks only nltl:supportingStructureAtOrBelowIceBeltLowerLimit and nltl:sameScantlingsAsMainFrame on the intermediate frame, omitting the verified note that applicable adjacent main frames must be ice strengthened. Keep these datatype facts on their authoritative frame owners and retain the direct-attachment and restricted intermediate alternative logic.

rows: Repair the alternative logic: the top-level sh:or permits an invalid unattached main frame to pass whenever the conditional branch conforms, because that branch explicitly allows ?partType = nltl:mainFrame without requiring direct attachment. Encode one per-strengthened-part constraint requiring direct attachment for every mainFrame and intermediateIceFrame, with the horizontal-connection alternative permitted only for an intermediateIceFrame whose termination structure is at or below the ice-belt lower limit, whose horizontal member connects to an adjacent mainFrame, and whose scantlings match the main frame; retain the adjacent main-frame ice-strengthening requirement. Also remove or correctly scope the unrelated global FILTER NOT EXISTS using unbound ?partTypeValue, which can suppress valid alternatives based on data elsewhere.

The alternative structure now prevents an unattached ordinary main-frame branch, but the horizontal-connection alternative is still too broad: its hasTerminationBelowSupportingStructure node is only constrained to supportingStructure and may therefore be an arbitrary supporting structure, rather than a deck, tank-boundary plating, tank top, or ice stringer at or below the ice-belt lower limit. Constrain that termination node to the same permitted supporting-structure alternatives plus the at-or-below condition. Also prevent an intermediate branch from applying to a node typed mainFrame (or otherwise enforce disjoint applicability), so a multiply typed main/intermediate strengthened part cannot pass solely through the horizontal alternative. Preserve the repaired per-part direct-main/intermediate-alternative logic and keep the unrelated global unbound-variable filter removed.

Preserve the prior repairs: retain direct attachment for every main/intermediate frame part, restrict the horizontal alternative to an intermediate part with an allowed termination structure at or below the ice-belt lower limit, and retain the adjacent-main-frame and same-scantlings checks. Remove gen:TRF047MainFrameStrengtheningShape, because targeting every nltl:mainFrame makes the conditional statement that main frames below the ice belt are strengthened into an unconditional requirement; keep that check only within the horizontal-connection alternative unless an explicit below-ice-belt applicability input is supplied. Also correct the owner/domain placement of supportingStructureAtOrBelowIceBeltLowerLimit, sameScantlingsAsMainFrame, and mainFrameBelowIceBeltStrengthened: the candidate places these datatype properties on supporting structures, horizontal members, and main-frame nodes although their supplied canonical domain is benchmarkEntity and their authoritative required owner is frame. Use the supplied specific frame-owner path/model rather than relocating facts to nested entities or benchmarkEntity, and ensure the outer frame target does not impose this requirement on unrelated frame types.

Preserve the prior repairs, but add the required adjacent-main-frame ice-strengthening check to the horizontal-connection alternative. When the intermediate frame has an allowed termination below a supporting structure at or below the ice-belt lower limit and connects to ?adjacentMainFrame, require ?adjacentMainFrame nltl:mainFrameBelowIceBeltStrengthened true. The current SPARQL checks only nltl:supportingStructureAtOrBelowIceBeltLowerLimit and nltl:sameScantlingsAsMainFrame on the intermediate frame, omitting the verified note that applicable adjacent main frames must be ice strengthened. Keep these datatype facts on their authoritative frame owners and retain the direct-attachment and restricted intermediate alternative logic.
